description.value: Retasket Lodge & RV Park is a 20-room motel and 8-site RV park set on a hilltop above Lillooet, proudly owned and operated by the T'it'q'et First Nation, with 360-degree views over the Fraser River and surrounding mountains. The property also offers Seton Lake Cabins — four separate lakeside cabins with full kitchens, sleeping up to six — a short distance from Seton Lake's beach and boat launch. Lillooet sits at a crossroads of several major cycling routes and the amenities page calls out mountain biking, hiking, and gold panning among nearby activities.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is comprehensive and confirms OSM contact details (address, phone). No mention of bike storage, laundry, or any cycling-specific amenities anywhere on the site. Wi-Fi is explicitly confirmed throughout the property including RV sites ('free, dedicated, high-speed Wi-Fi hotspots in every room' and 'Wi-Fi throughout the site'). The amenities page lists mountain biking as a nearby activity, indicating the area is relevant to cyclists, but no bike-handling infrastructure is described.
concerns: OSM name uses ampersand ('Retasket Lodge & RV Park') while the website consistently uses 'and' ('Retasket Lodge and RV Park') — minor stylistic discrepancy, OSM form retained per rules.
OSM lists only one phone number; website also advertises a toll-free number (1-866-456-2090) not present in OSM tags.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly bookable accommodation in Lillooet with a functional website and confirmed contact details — straightforward include.
enrichment_extras.notes: Website email (frontdesk@retasketlodge.com) is not in the OSM record and could be added. The property's cabins at Seton Lake are a separate physical location from the main motel/RV site — a future OSM record for the cabins may be warranted.

wow_evidence: proudly owned and operated by the T'it'q'et First Nation, with 360-degree views over the Fraser River
